title: Synthesis and Structure of the First Trinuclear, Half-Sandwich Carboranegadolinium(III) Cluster

material_class.structural_family: μ3-oxo-bridged trinuclear half-sandwich closo-gadolinacarborane with lithiacarborane bridges

synthesis.procedure: THF-solvated Li2[2,3-(SiMe3)2C2B4H4] (2, 6.4 mmol) was allowed to react with anhydrous GdCl3 (0.84 g, 3.18 mmol; molar ratio 2:1) in dry benzene (25 mL) at 0 °C for 24 h, during which the solution turned yellow. The heterogeneous mixture was filtered through a frit in vacuo and the solvent was removed from the filtrate to leave a pale-yellow solid. The solid was dissolved in hexane/THF (95:5) and filtered in vacuo. Slow removal of the solvents from the second filtrate gave light yellow, highly air- and moisture-sensitive crystals of 1.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C (reaction); crystallization by slow solvent removal (temperature not specified)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reaction in dry benzene; vacuum filtration through a frit
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: vacuum filtration of the heterogeneous mixture; solvent removal to a pale-yellow solid; redissolution in hexane/THF (95:5); second vacuum filtration; slow removal of solvents to give air- and moisture-sensitive crystals

properties.summary: Paramagnetism of 1 was noted only as precluding useful NMR data; no magnetic susceptibility, magnetization, or optical/luminescence measurements were reported. IR B–H stretches are vibrational characterization, not optical properties.
